findings.analysis: The overview correctly identifies stale claimed coverage. Frozen head 2c9b1d89a7673cef295c91a4e022d9da364b7328 explicitly says "Remove Muzzle resolution diagnostics functional tests as requested" and deletes MuzzleResolutionDiagnosticsTest.java and gradleTestKit(). Its parent 67c6e3212ac0eaafcdce140a6496cd0852d17399 had introduced the relevant tests. Preserve the deliberate later removal and remove only the inaccurate regression-coverage sentence from the description. Existing plugin tests pass, but do not cover diagnostics or configuration-cache reuse.

The missing functional coverage is real, but adding it back would undo the explicit "as requested" removal in frozen head 2c9b1d89a7673cef295c91a4e022d9da364b7328, which removed six diagnostic/cache tests and their TestKit dependency. Independent implementation evidence supports retaining the code: muzzle-check.gradle.kts:383-396 retains lenient resolution and captures only stack-trace strings for assertPass; lines 415-428 log those strings only after validation throws, then rethrow the same exception. MuzzleGradlePluginUtil.kt:87-96 still decides validation success/failure. Correct the stale description rather than inventing a requirement to restore deliberately removed tests. The existing three unit tests passed; no claim of diagnostic-path or cache-reuse validation is made.

proposal.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Failed Muzzle `assertPass` checks currently hide exceptions collected during lenient dependency resolution. This change exposes those exceptions and their causes without changing compatibility decisions.

- **Diagnostics:** Report resolution failures only when `assertPass` validation throws, then rethrow the original Muzzle exception. Successful checks and `assertFail` checks remain unchanged.
- **Configuration cache:** Capture diagnostics as text rather than Gradle resolution objects.

Resolution failures are diagnostic evidence, not proof of what caused a Muzzle mismatch.
proposal.title: Expose resolution diagnostics when Muzzle assertPass fails

### 🟡 Changes recommended The claimed regression coverage for diagnostics and configuration-cache reuse is absent.
1 open finding - [Add tests for diagnostics and configuration-cache reuse](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20581#discussion_r4262565748) · New
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced

[Testing] The stated regression coverage is not present in this change: the existing Gradle-plugin tests only exercise `AcceptableVersions` and `MuzzleDirective`, so neither the new diagnostic path nor configuration-cache reuse is verified. Please add a functional test with a lenient resolution failure that checks diagnostics appear only for a failing `assertPass`, the original Muzzle failure remains the task failure, and a second `--configuration-cache` run reuses the cache.
